$doc: Vyomi capability registry — Pub/Sub. One entry per console section; level per substrate (nano = shared core, also dev_server/unified ingress; offline = appliance). Proven by tests/conformance/test_capabilities.py — a claim the backend does not honour fails CI.

gcp.pubsub.topics.config.title: Topic labels, message retention and CMEK
limitations: Labels are stored and returned exactly as configured.

messageRetentionDuration is ENFORCED: Vyomi keeps a replayable backlog of every message published to the topic for that long, independent of any subscription, so subscriptions.seek can replay by timestamp — even from a subscription created after the message was published.

kmsKeyName is stored and returned, but Vyomi does not call Cloud KMS to encrypt/decrypt message data — there is no real encryption-at-rest difference between a Google-managed key and a customer-managed one in Vyomi.

gcp.pubsub.topics.schema.title: Attach a schema to a topic
limitations: schemaSettings (schema name + encoding) is stored on the topic and returned as configured.

A message published with JSON encoding against an AVRO schema IS validated — required fields and primitive/record/array/map/enum shapes are checked, and a violating message is rejected rather than published.
BINARY-encoded Avro and PROTOCOL_BUFFER schemas are not decoded, so messages in those encodings still publish unvalidated.

gcp.pubsub.subscriptions.pull-ack.title: Pull, acknowledge, ack-deadline redelivery, message retention
limitations: A message not acknowledged within ackDeadlineSeconds becomes eligible for redelivery the next time the subscription is pulled, rather than on a background timer.

gcp.pubsub.subscriptions.push.title: Push delivery config
limitations: pushConfig.pushEndpoint is stored and returned exactly as configured.
Vyomi never makes the outbound HTTP call — a push subscriber is not actually invoked. Use Pull delivery to receive messages in Vyomi.

gcp.pubsub.subscriptions.ordering-exactl.title: Message ordering and exactly-once delivery flags
limitations: enableMessageOrdering is ENFORCED: when set, the next message for a given orderingKey is never delivered until the earlier message with that key has been acknowledged, even if its own ack deadline has lapsed.
enableExactlyOnceDelivery is stored and returned as configured, but Vyomi does not deduplicate redelivered messages — a subscriber may still see a message more than once.

gcp.pubsub.subscriptions.retry-policy.title: Retry policy (immediate vs. exponential backoff)
limitations: minimumBackoff/maximumBackoff are ENFORCED: a redelivery is withheld until the exponential backoff window (capped at maximumBackoff) has elapsed, not just the ack deadline.
As with all pull-based redelivery, the backoff only takes effect on the subscriber's next pull call rather than via a background timer.

gcp.pubsub.subscriptions.filter.title: Subscription message filter
limitations: A documented subset of the filter language is evaluated at publish time: attributes.key = "value", attributes.key != "value", hasPrefix(attributes.key, "prefix"), attributes:"key" (has-attribute), NOT/AND/OR and parentheses.

The ':' substring-match form on a value (e.g. attributes.key:"-suffix") and any CEL-style expressions beyond this subset aren't implemented; an unparsable filter is rejected when the subscription is created, not silently ignored.

gcp.pubsub.subscriptions.bigquery-gcs-de.title: Write to BigQuery / write to Cloud Storage delivery
limitations: BigQuery and Cloud Storage aren't Vyomi products yet, so there is nowhere for this delivery type to write. Choose Pull or Push instead.

gcp.pubsub.topics.ingestion.title: Topic ingestion from external sources (AWS/Azure/Kafka/CDC)
limitations: Vyomi has no connectors to AWS, Azure, Kafka or database CDC sources, so a topic can't be configured to ingest from them.

gcp.pubsub.topics.message-transforms.title: Message transforms (JavaScript UDFs on publish)
limitations: Vyomi does not run a JavaScript transform pipeline on published messages.

gcp.pubsub.metrics.title: Topic / subscription metrics and monitoring charts
limitations: Vyomi does not collect the time-series metrics (throughput, backlog, oldest unacked age) the console's Metrics tab charts.

gcp.pubsub.snapshots.crud.title: Snapshots (create, list, get, delete) and seek
